say:1:1630440001:1.text: You like gods? Dogs love gods!
say:1:1630440001:1.source_cn: 你喜欢神吗？小狗也最喜欢神了！
say:1:1630440001:1.male: You like gods? Dogs love gods!
say:1:1630440001:1.female: You like gods? Dogs love gods!

say:2:1630440002:1.text: Dog. God. See? The gods even flipped their name around just for dogs! That's how you know they're awesome!
say:2:1630440002:1.source_cn: 神把祂的名字反过来给了狗狗！所以神很棒！
say:2:1630440002:1.male: Dog. God. See? The gods even flipped their name around just for dogs! That's how you know they're awesome!
say:2:1630440002:1.female: Dog. God. See? The gods even flipped their name around just for dogs! That's how you know they're awesome!

say:3:1630440003:1.text: So maybe there's a Dog God... or a God Dog... Either way, it's pawsitively divine, right?
say:3:1630440003:1.source_cn: 说不定还会有狗狗神，神狗狗……总之很棒，不是吗？
say:3:1630440003:1.male: So maybe there's a Dog God... or a God Dog... Either way, it's pawsitively divine, right?
say:3:1630440003:1.female: So maybe there's a Dog God... or a God Dog... Either way, it's pawsitively divine, right?
